td.div: 中文：​微软公司 目前的的徽标，于2012年8月23日推出。
English: Microsoft Corporation current logo, introduced on August 23, 2012.
Español: Actual logotipo de Microsoft Corporation, introducido el 23 de agosto del 2012.
Suomi: Microsoft Corporationin nykyinen logo, otettu käyttöön 23. elokuuta 2012.
Français : Logo actuel de Microsoft Corporation introduit le 23 août 2012.
हिन्दी: माइक्रोसॉफ्ट कॉर्पोरेशन का वर्तमान लोगो, जिसका इस्तेमाल पहली बार 23 अगस्त 2012 को किया गया था।
Italiano: Logo attuale di Microsoft, introdotto il 23 agosto 2012.
Deutsch: Aktuelles Logo von Microsoft, eingeführt am 23. August 2012.
日本語: マイクロソフトの現在のロゴ、2012年8月23日 (現地時間) に導入。
ქართული: კორპორაცია Microsoft-ის 2012 წლის 23 აგვისტოს გამოშვებული მიმდინარე ლოგო.
Português: Atual logotipo da Microsoft Corporation, introduzido em 23 de agosto de 2012.
Română: Logotipul actual al Corporației Microsoft, introdus pe 23 august 2012.
Українська: Сучасний логотип Microsoft, використовується з 23 серпня 2012 року.
Русский: Актуальный логотип Корпорации Microsoft, выпущенный 23 августа 2012.

tr.td: 23 August 2012 (minor fixes afterwards — see file history below)
Flipgrid (english). Microsoft (June 18, 2018). Retrieved on May 21, 2021. (Direct link).

td.div: There are many logos and trademarks in the United States that are not protected by copyright because they are below the threshold of originality required for copyright protection. There are some cases that even logos and trademarks that have been judged to be copyrighted in foreign countries have also been judged not to be copyrighted in the United States. However, some logos and trademarks are copyrighted in the United States. See COM:CRT/United States#Threshold of originality for more information.
